criteria.criterion: Access legislation.gov.uk and reach Data Protection Act 2018 in Original (As enacted) Introductory Text (or clearly report blocker)
criteria.final_justification: Evidence supports that the agent reached the Introduction section in Original (As enacted) and viewed the Introductory Text content. This satisfies the navigation requirement.

criteria.criterion: Record chapter number exactly as displayed (as enacted)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s reported chapter number matches the screenshot exactly.

criteria.criterion: Record complete long title exactly as displayed (as enacted)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s long title transcription matches what is displayed (including punctuation and “Commissioner’s”).

criteria.criterion: Record Royal Assent date exactly as displayed (as enacted)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported the Royal Assent date exactly as displayed (including brackets and ordinal). Baseline justification claiming a formatting difference is contradicted by the screenshot.

criteria.criterion: Count top-level Parts in as-enacted table of contents (Parts only, exclude nested Parts in Schedules)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s output states there are 7 top-level Parts, but this count is not verifiable from the provided visual evidence (only PART 1 is visible). Since the agent did provide the correct expected count, award partial credit rather than full because it is unsupported by screenshots here.

criteria.criterion: Count top-level Schedules in as-enacted table of contents (each counted once)
criteria.final_justification: The schedules count is both (a) unsupported by the screenshots and (b) indicated in the rubric notes as not matching the actual number. This is a substantive error, so no credit.
